definitions.full: H5789. ush [ עוּשׁ ] verb si vera lectio, lend aid, come to help (Arabic IV. aid, succour ; Sabean עֿותֿ noun help , SabDenkm 91 ; Nabataean, Sinaitic עות in proper name Lzb 337 Cook 90 ); — Qal Imperative masculine plural וָבֹאוּ עוּשׁוּ Joel 4:11 but dubious; Gr Dr, plausibly, חוּשׁוּ ; Che Expos., Nov. 1897, 365 גְּשׁוּ (√ נגשׁ ); עוּרוּ We Now.
